Identity capability: Tenant/Workspace/Membership aggregates with FK-enforced isolation
Identity capability: PostgresRepository base class with version-based optimistic concurrency (PR-003 compliant)
LawyersHub product context provider (productId=lawyershub, branding, features)

Staging deployment: Docker compose (postgres:5433, web:3001, caddy:80/443)

reusable_existing.name: Signup + Session Creation Flow
reusable_existing.note: Creates user + tenant + workspace + membership + session in one transaction. Accepts productId (default lawyershub). Uses Postgres when DATABASE_URL is set.

reusable_existing.name: Login Flow
reusable_existing.note: Authenticates user against Postgres, resolves primary membership + tenant + workspace. Sets WORKSPACE_SESSION_COOKIE with httpOnly+lax.

reusable_existing.name: Session Validation
reusable_existing.note: Reads session cookie, validates against Postgres sessions table, returns authenticated status + session context. Fail-closed on invalid session.

reusable_existing.name: Tenant Creation with Slug Resolution
reusable_existing.note: Creates tenant with auto-slugification and conflict resolution. FK-enforced owner_id to users table.

reusable_existing.name: Workspace Creation Flow
reusable_existing.note: Creates workspace bounded to tenant + productId, auto-creates owner membership. FK: tenant_id → tenants.id, UNIQUE(slug, tenant_id).

reusable_existing.name: Membership + Role Aggregates
reusable_existing.note: Role type: owner | admin | member. UNIQUE(user_id, workspace_id) constraint prevents duplicate memberships.

reusable_existing.name: Postgres Repository Base Class
reusable_existing.note: PR-003 compliant: version integer auto-increment, concurrent modification detection via version mismatch error.

reusable_existing.name: Legal Case Postgres Repository
reusable_existing.note: Has work_id for Work Identity anchoring, tenant_id + workspace_id FK isolation columns.

reusable_existing.name: Identity Schema Auto-initialization
reusable_existing.note: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for all 8 tables. Idempotent (schemaInitialized guard). ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS for migrations.

reusable_existing.name: P8 Experiment Restart Pattern
reusable_existing.note: Demonstrates in-process nullification of all state followed by fresh PostgreSQL reconstruction. Validates 7 invariants (work_id, tenant_id, workspace_id, actor_id, status, priority, version).

reusable_existing.name: Evidence Audit Trail Format
reusable_existing.note: Structured evidence format: status, environment_config, evidence (dns/tls/http/reverse_proxy/application), audit_trail with timestamped actions.

reusable_existing.name: Staging Docker Compose Stack
reusable_existing.note: PostgreSQL 15 on 5433, Next.js web on 3001, Caddy reverse proxy on 80/443. Service dependencies with healthcheck conditions. Persistent volumes: postgres_data, web_state, caddy_data.

risk_items.description: No membership enforcement on command execution means actor from Tenant A can pass tenantId=Tenant-B to commands and access Tenant B's data (cross-tenant read/write possible via forged input). This is PRODUCTION BLOCKER for P4 (Tenant Isolation).
risk_items.mitigation: Add centralized membership check BEFORE command execution in capability registry. Membership table has UNIQUE(user_id, workspace_id) — use it for a fast FK lookup.

risk_items.description: Password hashing service: Need to verify passwordService uses actual bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 (not a stub). Weak hashing = P3 fail.
risk_items.mitigation: Inspect password.service.ts and run a test: create user with known password, verify stored hash is NOT plaintext and verify bcrypt-like format.

risk_items.description: In-memory repositories (CaseRepositoryInMemory, DocumentRepositoryInMemory) are still used when DATABASE_URL is not set. For production deployment, DATABASE_URL MUST be set and the code path MUST use Postgres repos. Need to verify the env-conditional in signup-and-session.command.ts (line 77-91) correctly selects Postgres repos in staging compose (WEB service sets DATABASE_URL in compose.yaml line 28).
risk_items.mitigation: Add startup assertion log: 'Using [Postgres|In-Memory] repositories' to make it visible which adapter is active in deployment.
